comparison.objective: Depin one connector terminal vs seat a swivelling tie-rod ball stud in a tapered knuckle hole.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade-under-tab insertion and axial extraction vs controlling an articulated swinging rod, squaring its stud, and pressing a taper home.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits intact and alone vs stud reaches tight pose/depth tolerances and remains still.
comparison.reason: The record tests articulated alignment and tapered seating, not latch release.
